t: Prepare emergency situation status reports that describe response and recovery efforts, needs, and preliminary damage assessments.
Develop and maintain liaisons with municipalities, county departments, and similar entities to facilitate plan development, response effort coordination, and exchanges of personnel and equipment.
Keep informed of activities or changes that could affect the likelihood of an emergency, response efforts, or plan implementation.
